_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Craft Trial Report
summary: The Craft Trial Report documents the results of tests, inspections, and operations conducted during Shakedown Trials (ST) or Underway Trials (UT).
use_relationship:
The Craft Trial Report documents the results of tests, inspections, and operations conducted during Shakedown Trials (ST) or Underway Trials (UT).
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Trial Report shall be presented in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Trial Report shall include:

children.title: Cover.
children.content: The cover shall contain the following information:

children.title: Table of Contents.
children.content: The Table of Contents shall indicate the major sections and include a listing of all tests contained in the Trial Report. One complete Table of Contents covering the total set of volumes and appendixes shall be included at the front of volume 1. Each subsequent volume and appendix shall have a separate Table of Contents covering the material contained in that volume.

children.title: Introduction and Summary.
children.content: A brief introduction to the Trial Report and narrative summary of trial conditions, performance, and results shall be included. The Summary shall include as applicable:

children.title: Kind of underwater paint and days out of drydock since the last complete underwater painting.
List of underwater appendages not installed at the time of the Trial.
Sea state and weather conditions during the Trial.
List of uncompleted tests and events and the reasons for not completing them.
Trial Agenda.
children.content: The Trial Agenda under which the Trial was conducted shall be included together with all completed test and trial event results. The test and trial event results shall include as applicable:

children.title: Unsatisfactory Test Results.
children.content: Explanations of why tests were partially completed or not started and the reason why unsatisfactory test were unsatisfactory shall be included.

children.title: Appendix.
children.content: Raw data or data recordings of unusual size or format shall be presented as a separate appendix.
